map.衡量材料轴向刚度: Measures axial stiffness of a material
map.E = sigma / epsilon（单向应力/应变比），单位 Pa。钢 E: E = sigma / epsilon (uniaxial stress/strain ratio), unit Pa. Steel E about 200 GPa is very stiff, rubber about 0.01 GPa very soft; larger E is harder to stretch-deform.
map.同应力下 E 小的材料应变大（更软）。ΔL = F*L0/(E*A)，桥/: Under the same stress, a material with smaller E has larger strain (softer). ΔL = F*L0/(E*A), bridge/
map.E 大代表什么？: What does a large E mean?
map.轴向刚度大、难拉伸压缩；不代表强度高（强度看屈服极限）。金刚石 E 大也脆。: Large axial stiffness, hard to stretch/compress; does not mean high strength (strength is the yield limit). Diamond has large E yet is brittle.
map.杨氏模量和刚度关系？: What is the relation between Young's modulus and stiffness?
map.E 是材料本征刚度（单位应变的应力）；结构刚度还取决于形状（A、L），E*A/L: E is the intrinsic material stiffness (stress per unit strain); structural stiffness also depends on shape (A, L), and E*A/L is the member's axial stiffness.
